title: Packet compiler: qualifiers, approved copy and privacy are never shortened; pressure is reported
note: Synthetic. Lists the function exercised and the expected outcome; no token count, price or latency here is a measurement.
setup: run with research/claims.json containing a claim with qualifier 'in the US only' and a protected number; brief.must_show with approved copy; plan.local non-empty; per_packet_start.build set tiny via productionPolicy packet_budget
expect: the mandatory section contains the qualifier text, the protected tokens, the approved copy and the privacy line verbatim
receipt.pressure.pressure is true with over_by > 0 and the action says nothing was truncated
optional slices (story-beats, storyboard-shots) move to omitted_optional with a ref; mandatory sections are still included
estimate_note says bytes/4 estimates, not tokenizer counts; no network call is made
